usage: sot-validator history [-h] [--db-path DB_PATH] [--import-json IMPORT_JSON]
                             [--record RESULTS_FILE] [--run-id RUN_ID] [--recorded-at RECORDED_AT]
                             [--site-id SITE_ID] [--min-consecutive-stale MIN_CONSECUTIVE_STALE]
                             [--export-json EXPORT_JSON] [--drift-output DRIFT_OUTPUT]
                             [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --db-path DB_PATH     Path to SQLite HistoryStore database or exported JSON file (default:
                        ./history.db).
  --import-json IMPORT_JSON
                        Optional HistoryStore JSON state file to import before processing.
  --record, --results-file RESULTS_FILE
                        Path to validation_results.json to record as a new validation run.
  --run-id RUN_ID       Optional explicit run ID when recording a run or querying drift.
  --recorded-at RECORDED_AT
                        Optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when recording a validation run.
  --site-id SITE_ID     Optional site ID filter for streaks and drift events.
  --min-consecutive-stale MIN_CONSECUTIVE_STALE
                        Minimum consecutive stale runs filter when listing item streaks (default:
                        0).
  --export-json EXPORT_JSON
                        Optional path to export full HistoryStore state as JSON.
  --drift-output, --output-file DRIFT_OUTPUT
                        Optional file path to write JSON summary of runs, streaks, and drift
                        events.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Optional directory to write history_summary.json and drift_report.json.
